argument.script: async (intermediate) => { const dryrun = {{ dryrun }} || false; const user_id = '{{ user_id }}'; const group_id = '{{ group_id }}'; const panelTop = document.querySelector('main .woo-panel-top'); const buttons = panelTop ? panelTop.querySelectorAll('button') : []; let followBtn = null; for (const btn of buttons) { const txt = (btn.innerText || btn.textContent || '').trim(); if (txt === '关注' || txt === 'Follow' || txt === '+ 关注') { followBtn = btn; break; } } const isFollowing = !followBtn; if (!isFollowing && followBtn) { console.log('Need to follow first'); followBtn.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000)); } if (dryrun) return [{ status: 'dryrun', message: 'Dryrun mode - user ready for grouping', user_id, group_id, was_following: isFollowing }]; const resp = await fetch('/ajax/profile/setGroup', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ uids: user_id, list_ids: group_id, origin_list_ids: '0' }) }); const text = await resp.text(); let data; try { data = JSON.parse(text); } catch (e) { return [{ status: 'error', message: 'API error: ' + resp.status + ' - ' + text.substring(0, 100), user_id, group_id }]; } if (data.ok || data.result) { return [{ status: 'success', message: 'User added to group', user_id, group_id }]; } return [{ status: 'error', message: data.msg || 'Failed to add to group', user_id, group_id }]; }

variables.name: user_id
variables.help: User ID to add to group
